findings.message: 28 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "IN THE HAUS", "H4", "HAUS MEMBERSHIP", "HAUS SIGNATURES").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "ระบบระบุพิกัดไม่พร้อมใช้งาน · ออเดอร์ของ" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "ระบุเบอร์โทรเพื่อสะสมแต้ม xhaus & แก้ว 1" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "/ เมนูแนะนำ" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "รายการที่สั่ง" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: 1 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 25px 50px -12px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.

findings.message: 132 panel borders are dark against their ground: #d5cbc9 on #faf3f2 (1.45:1) | #d5cbc9 on #faf3f2 (1.45:1) | #d5cbc9 on #faf3f2 (1.45:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.

findings.message: 131 icons sit in tinted squares or circles.
findings.fix: This is the commonest tell of a generated dashboard. Drop the tinted square: a KPI is a label and a number; an icon, if it helps, is plain and in the text colour.

findings.message: 30 text blocks under 11px: WAITING STAFF 9px, ดูสถานะ 10px, EDIT 10px, ระบุเบอร์โทรเพื่อสะสมแต้ 10px.
Only 2 of 127 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 4 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 54px in "Keychain (small)", 54px in "Haus duo color keytag", 52px in "ใบเหลียงผัดไข่ในบ้าน".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.
Name the screen in an h1 at the top of the canvas (18–28px): "Overview", "Payouts", the project's name.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "IN THE HAUS" (14px); "Vegetarian" (12px); "Set : จับคู่จานเดียว + Set : ใ" (12px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
